name: DeleteRowFromExcelWorksheet
label: Delete Row from Excel Worksheet
description: Deletes a specific row from the specified worksheet of an Excel workbook.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the row will be deleted.

fields.name: RowIndex
fields.label: Row Index
fields.description: The index (1-based) of the row to delete.
